usedFor: Jobber holds quotes; “When a quote is approved” can write to Google Docs via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a quote is approved” in Jobber, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: An approved quote is where a job becomes real, and the action writes text into a chosen doc tab.

watchOut: “When a job is updated” fires on each change, so one job can write to the same tab twice.
